items.headline: Brad Dalke's PGA Tour Debut
items.text: YouTube star Brad Dalke received a sponsor exemption to play at the PGA Tour’s Rocket Classic at Detroit Golf Club July 30–August 2, marking his pro debut.

items.headline: Jon Rahm Opts Out of LIV Pitching
items.text: Jon Rahm declined to help LIV Golf seek new investors, citing lack of business knowledge and focusing solely on playing golf, while Bryson DeChambeau continues investor outreach.
